description.value: A dual-concept restaurant combining Ricky's breakfast café with Famoso Pizzeria, allowing cyclists to stop for either breakfast or pizza at a single location. Both brands operate together under FDF Restaurant Brandz ownership and management. This location on Sumas Way offers diverse dining options for touring cyclists.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 32m; wall_loops (8 spaces) at 93m. Total: 10 spaces.

raw_osm.comment: both restaurant brands owned currently by "FDF Restaurant Brandz " and both in location are run by a single franchisee.  Interesingly hours of operation are listed different on the respective websites.
